units.leftText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
units.rightText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ,

units.leftText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
units.rightText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood:

units.leftText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
units.rightText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
rightNotes: 1:3 Or has caused us to be born again or has begotten us again

units.leftText: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
units.rightText: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,

units.leftText: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
units.rightText: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

units.leftText: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
units.rightText: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials

units.leftText: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
units.rightText: so that the proven character of your faith — more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire — may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
units.rightText: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

units.leftText: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
units.rightText: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

units.leftText: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
units.rightText: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,

units.leftText: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
units.rightText: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.

units.leftText: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
units.rightText: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

units.leftText: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
units.rightText: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
leftNotes: 1:13 literally, “gird up the waist of your mind” or “put on the belt of the waist of your mind”
rightNotes: 1:13 Literally Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind

units.leftText: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
units.rightText: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

units.leftText: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
units.rightText: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,

units.leftText: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
units.rightText: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
rightNotes: 1:16 Leviticus 11:44–45|LEV 11:44-45*; Leviticus 19:2

units.leftText: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
units.rightText: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.

units.leftText: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
units.rightText: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,

units.leftText: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
units.rightText: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.

units.leftText: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
units.rightText: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.

units.leftText: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
units.rightText: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.

units.leftText: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
units.rightText: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
rightNotes: 1:22 SBL, NE, and WH from the heart

units.leftText: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
units.rightText: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

units.rightText: For,

units.rightText: but the word of the Lord stands forever.”

units.leftText: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
units.rightText: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.

units.leftText: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
units.rightText: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

units.leftText: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
units.rightText: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

units.leftText: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
units.rightText: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,

units.leftText: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: Because it is contained in Scripture,
units.rightText: For it stands in Scripture:

units.leftText: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,
units.rightText: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe,

units.rightText: and,

units.leftText: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
units.rightText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.

units.leftText: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
units.rightText: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

units.leftText: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
units.rightText: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.

units.leftText: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
units.rightText: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.

units.leftText: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
units.rightText: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,

units.leftText: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
units.rightText: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.

units.leftText: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
units.rightText: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.

units.leftText: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
units.rightText: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.

units.leftText: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
units.rightText: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
rightNotes: 2:17 Literally Love the brotherhood

units.leftText: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
units.rightText: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
rightNotes: 2:18 Or in all fear

units.leftText: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
units.rightText: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.

units.leftText: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
units.rightText: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

units.leftText: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
units.rightText: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:

units.leftText: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
units.rightText: “He committed no sin,

units.leftText: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
units.rightText: When they heaped abuse on Him,

units.leftText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
units.rightText: He Himself bore our sins
rightNotes: 2:24 Isaiah 53:4|ISA 53:4* (see also LXX)

units.leftText: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
units.rightText: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
leftNotes: 2:25 “Overseer” is from the Greek ἐπίσκοπον, which can mean overseer, curator, guardian, or superintendent.

units.leftText: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
units.rightText: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives

units.leftText: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
units.rightText: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.

units.leftText: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
units.rightText: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,

units.leftText: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
units.rightText: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.

units.leftText: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
units.rightText: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,

units.leftText: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
units.rightText: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.

units.leftText: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
units.rightText: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.

units.leftText: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
units.rightText: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.

units.leftText: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
units.rightText: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

units.leftText: For,
units.rightText: For,

units.leftText: Let him turn away from evil and do good.
units.rightText: He must turn from evil and do good;

units.leftText: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
units.rightText: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,

units.leftText: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
units.rightText: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?

units.leftText: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
units.rightText: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
rightNotes: 3:14 Or “Do not fear their threats; do not be shaken.”Isaiah 8:12|ISA 8:12*

units.leftText: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
units.rightText: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
rightNotes: 3:15 BYZ and TR But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts.This sentence may also be included with the quotation from the previous verse; see Isaiah 8:13|ISA 8:13*.

units.leftText: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
units.rightText: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.

units.leftText: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
units.rightText: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

units.leftText: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
units.rightText: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
rightNotes: 3:18 NE and WH died

units.leftText: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
units.rightText: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
rightNotes: 3:19 Or in the spirit, 19*in which

units.leftText: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
units.rightText: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built.

units.leftText: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
units.rightText: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also — not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God — through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
rightNotes: 3:21 Or appeal for

units.leftText: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
units.rightText: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.

units.leftText: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
units.rightText: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
rightNotes: 4:1 BYZ and TR include for us.

units.leftText: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
units.rightText: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.

units.leftText: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
units.rightText: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.

units.leftText: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
units.rightText: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.

units.leftText: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
units.rightText: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

units.leftText: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
units.rightText: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
rightNotes: 4:6 Or to those who are dead

units.leftText: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
units.rightText: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.

units.leftText: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
units.rightText: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
rightNotes: 4:8 See Proverbs 10:12|PRO 10:12*

units.leftText: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
units.rightText: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.

units.leftText: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
units.rightText: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.

units.leftText: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
units.rightText: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.

units.leftText: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
units.rightText: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.

units.leftText: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
units.rightText: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
rightNotes: 4:14 BYZ and TR include On their part He is spoken of as evil, but on your part He is glorified.

units.leftText: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
units.rightText: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.

units.leftText: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
units.rightText: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
rightNotes: 4:16 Literally glorify God in that name; NA glorify God in this matter

units.leftText: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
units.rightText: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?

units.leftText: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
units.rightText: And,

units.leftText: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
units.rightText: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

units.leftText: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
units.rightText: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
rightNotes: 5:1 SBL, NE, and WH I appeal therefore to the elders

units.leftText: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
units.rightText: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
rightNotes: 5:2 NE and WH do not include watching over them.
5:2 WH, BYZ, and TR but willingly

units.leftText: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
units.rightText: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

units.leftText: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
units.rightText: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

units.leftText: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
units.rightText: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because,

units.leftText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
units.rightText: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.

units.leftText: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
units.rightText: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

units.leftText: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
units.rightText: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

units.leftText: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
units.rightText: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.

units.leftText: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
units.rightText: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
rightNotes: 5:10 BYZ and TR in Christ Jesus

units.leftText: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
units.rightText: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
rightNotes: 5:12 That is, Silas

units.leftText: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
units.rightText: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
rightNotes: 5:13 Literally She in Babylon

units.leftText: Greet one another with a kiss of love.
units.rightText: Greet one another with a kiss of love.
